messages:
arun: heads up — multiple incident-channel alerts didn't trigger pages for on-call this morning. saw 502 from notify-proxy. opening thread so ops can coordinate.

pagerbot: AUTOMATED: failed to deliver page. notify-proxy returned 502. dedupe header missing -> suppression applied. request_id=abc123 route=us-west-2

megan: ugh. which customers impacted? any live user-facing degradations? @oncall_ryan can you take? :eyes:

oncall_ryan: I'm awake, no page came through. checking agent logs and alerts now.

arun: logs snippet: ```
ERROR notify-proxy: upstream 502 for /page -> body truncated; header 'X-Page-ID' missing
request_id=abc123
route=us-west-2
```

ops_bot: automation flagged this as 'suspicious' and squelched pages because dedupe header absent, to avoid duplicate fanout. policy: suppress if X-Page-ID == null.

megan: that squelch should not block primary pages. we need immediate manual page for high-sev customers. who's owning manual paging? :rotating_light:

sres: I can manual page. affected accounts from logs: acme-co, betaapp, hotel2. arun can you confirm impact and severity?

arun: confirmed acme-co + betaapp showed 5-10% increase in embeddings latency and ~2% error rate spikes. two support tickets already (INC-4599). linking: https://support.internal/INC-4599

oncall_ryan: manual paging initiated (SMS + voice) to oncall roster. also rolling back recent header-parse change in notify-proxy (reverting commit f7e1c2). ETA ~12m to validate.

megan: let's classify this P1 given paid-tenant impact >10% of requests for critical customers. notify CS and support.

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-4599. Runbook suggested: "notify-proxy 502 handling" -> https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/notify-proxy-502. @sre-team tagged.

sres: acme-co engineer replied: degraded but still returning responses (higher latency). They opened a support case and are monitoring. I'll collect request traces and prompt sets.

arun: mitigation steps executed: reverted header-parse change, disabled strict dedupe check, restarted notify-proxy pods in us-west-2. Monitoring dashboards show error-rate falling.

megan: after rollback, pages should be un-squelched. @pagerbot can you run a synthetic page test?

pagerbot: test page -> success. Sent synthetic page to @oncall_ryan via SMS and voice; ack received. :white_check_mark:

oncall_ryan: ack. paging pipeline looks healthy now. continuing to monitor tickets and latency metrics.

megan: follow-ups: 1) add explicit unit test for X-Page-ID presence detection, 2) change fail-closed to fail-open for missing dedupe header, 3) update runbook to include manual SMS fallback. I'll own postmortem.

arun: PR opened for fail-open and tests: https://git.redwood/notify-proxy/pulls/1234

ops_bot: closing live-mitigation thread. Postmortem owner: megan. ETA doc in 48h. :memo:
